rules.title: Return explains a short-bill
rules.plain: If units came back on a return before we finished billing the shipment, don't treat the gap as short-billed — the return explains it.

rules.title: Duplicate credit memo
rules.plain: If the same credit memo number appears twice (ignoring case and punctuation), the second one is an over-credit we can recover.

rules.title: Credit never issued
rules.plain: If goods were returned on a paid invoice and no credit memo exists, Northline owes the customer a credit.
